themes.name: 培養室
themes.background_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production raster asset for a 2D side-view pixel-art platform game about a small green slime escaping an abandoned biological factory. Cohesive premium hand-crafted pixel art, deliberate crisp square pixel clusters, restrained 16-bit palette, consistent upper-left light, subtle worn industrial materials, no painterly strokes, no smooth 3D rendering, no photographic textures. Asset type: one finished wide landscape background plate, ideally 1536x1024. Theme: Abandoned biological culture laboratory, desaturated teal and aged ivory, dormant cylindrical culture vessels behind glass, empty sample racks, old ceramic wall panels, fine trailing roots, drained nutrient plumbing. Composition: flat side-on elevation suitable behind gameplay, NOT a perspective corridor with a vanishing-point floor. Large quiet dark open central 65 percent, softly separated distant architectural layers. Detailed equipment concentrated at far lateral edges and upper perimeter; center contains only low contrast recessed wall shapes. Background only, edge-to-edge artwork, no borders. Foreground gameplay will be added by engine. No foreground floor, no platforms, no tile grid, no characters, no text, no logos, no arrows, no particle specks, no fog overlay, no bloom. Any indicator lamps very small and dim. Beautiful restrained atmospheric depth through value grouping.
